title: ICanGamez Softcore Gamemode
description: This is a mix between hardcore and regular survival!
body:
# Softcore Gamemode

What is it about?

Its about a gamemode harder than normal mode but you keep your world if you die


<details>
<summary>What happens why I die?</summary>

You get put into spectator mode

Then you are given a 30 second wait

After those 30 seconds your items will be gone and a temp debuff is placed

</details>
